title: The data of a plugin's status --json (SPEC CLI-12)
description: The keys every plugin's status carries. A plugin adds its own beside them (CLI-12), so other keys are allowed.

plugin.description: The install id, such as rk-weigh-in.

spec.description: The SPEC version the binary conforms to.

store.description: The store's path; null when it cannot be located.

store_source.description: The ST-03 step that chose the store; null when it cannot be located.

store_schema.description: <major>.<minor> of the store's stamp (ST-06); null when it was refused, cannot be located or does not exist yet.

unreadable.description: Events of the plugin's own types it skipped, by type (EV-10).

dropped.description: Telemetry events dropped on a busy lock since the count was last reported (ST-09).
